violations.text: The establishment did not have an allergen statement present for consumer awareness. An allergen statement was posted at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026
The menu is lacking an allergen statement for consumer awareness. All menus must contain "PLEASE INFORM YOUR SERVER OF ANY ALLERGIES". New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs and beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cheese and beans) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Foods were relocated to proper areas at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Various foods in the walk-in cooler were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. All foods to be used within 7 days of prep date. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of black residue. The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent possible contamination of foods. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The area around the dumpster was observed with an accumilation of debris and trash. The refuse areas must be cleaned and maintained as often as necessary to prevent harborage conditions for pests. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The pre-flush spray hose at the kitchen 3 bay sink is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. -Must be corrected before opening. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/10/2024

The walls in the corner of the kitchen are constructed of sheet rock. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. -Shall be corrected before opening. -Guidance for approved finished materials provided to establishment. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/24/2024

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

The pre-flush spray hose at the 3 bay sink is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

The ceiling in the kitchen area is covered with materials that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. -Ceilings shall be smooth, durable, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024

Some walls in the kitchen area and the front bar area are constructed of sheet rock. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2024
